result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by a large elevated transit structure, which creates significant visual obstructions with its massive support columns. While basic infrastructure like marked zebra crosswalks and pedestrian signals are present, the wide roadway and dark under-structure environment pose safety challenges for visibility and crossing distance.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Elevated Structure Columns
hazards.description: Large steel support columns for the overhead train tracks are positioned near the intersection, significantly blocking sightlines between turning drivers and pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners and along the curb line where the blue steel columns meet the ground.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to cross a significant distance, increasing their exposure time to traffic in an area with complex visual conditions.
hazards.location_in_image: The main intersection crossing in the foreground.

hazards.name: Low Light Environment
hazards.description: The overhead structure creates deep shadows even during the day, potentially making pedestrians less visible to motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: The entire roadway area underneath the blue steel structure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the corners to shorten crossing distances and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight past the support columns.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light, making them more visible in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Enhanced Under-Structure Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-output LED lighting on the underside of the elevated structure to improve visibility for all road users in the shadowed area.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is severely impacted by a massive elevated transit structure that creates significant visual obstructions and deep shadows. A large commercial vehicle is parked across the marked crosswalk, while structural pillars further block sightlines between pedestrians and motorists at the intersection.

hazards.name: Vehicle obstructing crosswalk
hazards.description: A large white van is parked directly over the marked crosswalk, forcing pedestrians to walk around it into traffic and blocking sightlines.

hazards.name: Structural pillars
hazards.description: Large steel pillars for the elevated train are located near the curb, creating significant blind spots for both pedestrians and drivers at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line, supporting the elevated structure.

hazards.name: Poor lighting under structure
hazards.description: The elevated transit structure creates deep shadows, making it difficult for drivers to see pedestrians, especially in low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement 'no standing' zones at the intersection to prevent vehicles from parking in or near the crosswalk, improving visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to move pedestrians past the structural pillars before they cross, improving their visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Enhanced Under-deck Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-intensity, pedestrian-scale lighting underneath the elevated structure to eliminate dark spots and improve safety.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide urban arterial with multiple travel lanes and a painted median. While sidewalks and bike lanes are present on both sides, the lack of marked crossings and the overall width of the roadway suggest a high-speed environment that is challenging for pedestrians to navigate safely.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway with multiple lanes and no physical refuge increases pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No marked pedestrian crossings are visible along this stretch of commercial frontage, potentially leading to unsafe mid-block crossings.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median refuge to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-Block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and appropriate signage to formalize pedestrian movements.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a very wide, well-maintained sidewalk directly adjacent to a multi-lane roadway. While the walkway itself is spacious and clear of obstructions, there is a lack of physical buffering from traffic and no visible crossing infrastructure for the wide street.

hazards.name: Lack of sidewalk buffer
hazards.description: Pedestrians on the wide sidewalk are directly adjacent to travel lanes without any physical separation like trees, bollards, or parked cars.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line separating the sidewalk from the roadway.

hazards.name: Wide crossing distance
hazards.description: The roadway is very wide with multiple lanes and no visible pedestrian refuge or marked crossing, making it difficult to cross safely.
hazards.location_in_image: The entire roadway area in the foreground.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Amenity Zone
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone with trees and benches to provide physical and psychological separation from moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Midblock Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to facilitate safe crossing to the health center.
